name: Foam RC Glider Jet — Twin Tail
description: A remote-control twin-tail jet made of impact-resistant EPP foam, about 36 x 26.5 cm, with flashing lights and automatic balance. It flies for about 15 minutes, with a remote range of about 150 m and a low-battery warning. The box holds the jet, remote, manual, 2 balance wings, 2 propellers, charger, 3 landing gear and battery.
